ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud schemes and identify patterns and connections between entities
questions: How do Medicaid fraud schemes work?
What are the most common methods of Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money in Medicaid fraud schemes could reveal important patterns and connections between entities. This could help identify key players and methods of fraud.
